## What's being archived
<!-- e.g. "Bead-pulls of CAV-02 at 60° and 112° (MEAS-2026-014, -015)" -->

## Checklist
- [ ] Each record has its required metadata (the **Validate archive** check is green)
- [ ] Files start with their record ID ([POL-002](../vault/Archive%20Policy/POL-002%20Naming%20conventions.md))
- [ ] Raw data copied to group storage, with location and `sha256` in `raw_data`
- [ ] `access` is set deliberately (`internal` / `collaboration` / `public`)
- [ ] Linked from the relevant apparatus logbook / memo / meeting
